32. While it is the RI and RC’s responsibility to make sure the works are carried out safely and properly, we had sought advice from the Fire Services Department and Mr Franko TSE, the then-Senior Building Surveyor/Building Control (one of the advisors seconded from BD who has now retired) regarding the use of foam boards to cover up the windows as temporary protection in the course of handling relevant complaints. ICU was given to understand that such use of foam boards was not considered as buildings works, and that there was neither requirement under the BO, nor stipulated guidelines in any regulations, rules, codes of practice and standards regarding the use of foam boards as temporary protection for windows.

33. Furthermore, in response to our enquiry during the site inspection on 28 October 2024, the RC, in the presence of the RI’s assigned person, said that they would use non-combustible materials for temporary protection of windows during the hacking off works, which would be removed immediately upon completion of the relevant works.
